cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The model is the reasoning core of an offline enterprise assistant: it reads a company's own documents (contracts, invoices, HR policies, meeting notes) from a local index and answers with citations, on a single laptop, with no network. It is load-bearing because the deployment target — SMEs and public bodies in francophone West Africa working through power cuts and metered data — cannot send those documents to a cloud provider at all, for cost and for confidentiality. The same core is reachable over USSD from a feature phone, with no data plan.

test_prompts.prompt: Voici un extrait de contrat fournisseur : « Le prestataire s'engage à livrer sous 30 jours calendaires. Tout retard supérieur à 10 jours ouvre droit à une pénalité de 2 % du montant hors taxes par semaine entamée, plafonnée à 10 %. » La livraison a 25 jours de retard sur une commande de 4 500 000 FCFA HT. Calcule la pénalité due, indique le plafond applicable, et cite la phrase du contrat sur laquelle tu t'appuies.

You are an offline assistant for a 40-person company. Summarise the following internal note for the management committee in exactly three bullet points, then list any information the note does NOT provide but that a decision-maker would need. Note: "Q3 revenue reached 182M FCFA, up 12% year on year. The Abidjan warehouse ran out of stock twice in September. Two of the four delivery vans were off the road for repairs. The new supplier contract has not been signed."
